name: Not Your Average Corporate Conference
source:
Harrison is sent on a trip with his work crush to represent his company at a big conference. He quickly learns that what happens at this conference isn't at all what he imagined it would be.

It's better!

This erotic bara visual novel let's you make choices for Harrison to determine what sexy scenarios he comes across. Will Harrison bring glory to his company? Will he get with his crush Darren? Will he connect with a hot stranger? That's all for you to decide.

[Edited from [url=https://beebadraws.itch.io/not-your-average-corporate-conference]itch.io[/url]]
